# Tiny Tides Therapy

> Pediatric occupational therapy and lactation counseling practice serving Baltimore City, MD and surrounding areas, with virtual appointments also available. Run by Erin, a Doctor of Occupational Therapy and Certified Lactation Counselor.

Tiny Tides Therapy helps infants and young children (birth through 24 months) with feeding, breastfeeding/lactation support, developmental milestones, sensory processing, and transitioning to solids. Services are provided in-home, virtually, and via free monthly groups in the Baltimore area.

## Contact

- Address: 1348 Andre St, Baltimore, MD 21230
- Phone: (410) 490-8440
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/tinytidestherapy/
- Website: https://www.tinytidestherapy.com/

## Services

- Discovery Call — FREE, 15 minutes: Free 15-minute consultation to see how Tiny Tides can support you and your little one.
- Initial Evaluation — $200, 60-90 minutes: In-home evaluation of breastfeeding/bottle feeding, oral motor skills, and general development, with a written summary and recommendations.
- Follow up Session — $125, 60-75 minutes: In-home individualized treatment plan based on your child's needs.
- Baby Bootcamp — $300, up to 3 hours: In-home support with feeding, diaper changes, sleep, and wake windows, plus an individualized activity plan.
- Virtual Appointment — $100, 30-45 minutes: Individualized virtual treatment session and coaching.
- Wave Watch (Virtual Milestone Checkup) — $50, 30-45 minutes: Virtual review of developmental milestones and guidance on supporting activities.

Full details: https://www.tinytidestherapy.com/services

## What We Treat

- Lactation Counseling: latch, positioning, oral motor skills, maternal factors, digestion, and other issues affecting breastfeeding.
- Occupational Therapy: motor skills, feeding challenges, sensory processing and regulation, and developmental milestones for infants.
- Transition to Solids: bottle feeding, starting solids, texture aversions, and picky eating.

Full details: https://www.tinytidestherapy.com/what-we-treat

## Frequently Asked Questions

Q: What ages do you work with?
A: We specialize in working with infants, toddlers, and young children, focusing on feeding, eating, and developmental milestones from birth through 24 months.

Q: What happens during the initial evaluation?
A: The initial evaluation includes a detailed discussion of your concerns, observation of your child's skills, and a collaborative plan to address your goals.

Q: What should I expect at the first visit?
A: A comprehensive evaluation of your current symptoms to determine the cause and contributing factors, resulting in an evidence-based, patient-centered plan of care.

Q: Do you take insurance?
A: Tiny Tides Therapy is an out-of-network clinic; sessions are paid at time of service via debit/credit card, FSA, or HSA. Services are covered under out-of-network benefits by most insurers, but reimbursement is not guaranteed.

Q: Do you offer virtual consultations?
A: Yes, for certain services such as lactation counseling and feeding guidance.

Full FAQ list: https://www.tinytidestherapy.com/faqs
